name: Deck of Many More Things
description: The complete 66-card Deck of Many More Things.

cards.name: Aberration
cards.description: Gain telepathy within 90 feet.

faces.text: You gain the ability to communicate telepathically with any creature you can see within 90 feet of you. The creature understands you only if the two of you share a language.

cards.name: Balance
cards.description: Take a 2-point penalty to Will saves, and gain a 2-point bonus to Deception, Diplomacy and Intimidation.

faces.text: Your mind suffers a wrenching alteration and your convictions invert. You take a -2 status penalty to Will saves, and gain a +2 status bonus to Deception, Diplomacy and Intimidation checks. The change is permanent.

cards.name: Beast
cards.description: Transform into a random animal battle form for 2d12 days.

faces.text: You are transformed into a random animal for 2d12 days. Your statistics are replaced by those of the battle form. You retain your personality and your memories.

cards.name: Book
cards.description: Learn 1d6+2 languages.

faces.text: You immediately learn 1d6+2 languages of your choice. You gain fluency in these languages as if you had studied them for years.

cards.name: Bridge
cards.description: Cast Time Freeze 1d3 times without spending a spell slot.

faces.text: You can cast Time Freeze 1d3 times without expending a spell slot. The uses are tracked on your sheet and are spent as you use them.

cards.name: Campfire
cards.description: Immediately gain the benefits of a full night's rest.

faces.text: You are immediately restored to full Hit Points, your focus points are refreshed, and your daily preparations are renewed as though you had rested for eight hours.

cards.name: Cavern
cards.description: Gain a climbing speed equal to your walking speed; climb surfaces freely.

faces.text: You gain a climbing speed equal to your current walking speed and can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make a check.

cards.name: Celestial
cards.description: Sprout luminescent wings: a 30-foot fly Speed, and bright light for 20 feet.

faces.text: Wings of light unfold from your shoulders. You gain a fly Speed of 30 feet, and you shed bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for 20 feet beyond that.

cards.name: Comet
cards.description: If you solo-defeat the next hostile creature(s) you encounter, gain 1 level.

faces.text: If you single-handedly defeat the next hostile creature or group of creatures you encounter, you gain enough experience to advance one level. Otherwise, this card has no effect.

cards.name: Construct
cards.description: A homunculus appears and treats you as its creator.

faces.text: A homunculus appears in an unoccupied space within 30 feet of you. It treats you as its creator and is loyal to you for as long as it lives.

cards.name: Corpse
cards.description: You drop to 0 Hit Points and enter Dying 1; only a wish-tier miracle can restore you.

faces.text: You immediately drop to 0 Hit Points, fall unconscious and enter Dying 1. If you die from this effect, only a wish-tier divine miracle can bring you back.

cards.name: Crossroads
cards.description: Roll d20: even = age 1d10 years older; odd = 1d10 years younger.

faces.text: Roll a d20. On an even result, you age 1d10 years. On an odd result, you become 1d10 years younger (minimum 1 year old). The change is instantaneous and permanent.

cards.name: Donjon
cards.description: Entombed in an extradimensional sphere; you draw no more cards.

faces.text: You disappear and become entombed in a state of suspended animation in an extradimensional sphere. Everything you were wearing and carrying stays behind in the space you occupied. You remain there until you are found and removed. You draw no more cards.

cards.name: Door
cards.description: Cast Gate 1d4 times without spending a spell slot or components.

faces.text: You can cast Gate 1d4 times without expending a spell slot or material components. The uses are tracked on your sheet.

cards.name: Dragon
cards.description: A dragon suited to your own power appears; it takes you for its parent and is loyal.

faces.text: A dragon of a kind chosen by the GM appears in an unoccupied space within 30 feet of you. It is no greater than your own level — a drake or dragonet early on, a true dragon later — and it takes you for its parent, loyal for as long as you both live.

cards.name: Elemental
cards.description: Become immune to one of acid, cold, fire, electricity or sonic damage.

faces.text: You become immune to one damage type of your choice: acid, cold, fire, electricity or sonic.

cards.name: Euryale
cards.description: You suffer a −2 penalty on saving throws until removed by divine intervention.

faces.text: The card's medusa-like visage curses you. You suffer a −2 penalty on all saving throws. Only a god or the magic of the Fates card (or equivalent divine intervention) can end this curse.

cards.name: Expert
cards.description: Your Dexterity modifier increases by 1, to a maximum of +7.

faces.text: Your Dexterity modifier increases by 1, to a maximum of +7. The boost is permanent.

cards.name: Fates
cards.description: Erase one event as if it never happened; usable anytime before your death.

faces.text: Reality's fabric unravels and reshapes itself, allowing you to avoid or erase one event as if it never happened. You can use the card's magic as soon as you draw the card or at any other time before your death.

cards.name: Fey
cards.description: You are pulled into the Feywild through a fey crossing; you draw no more cards.

faces.text: You are pulled through a spontaneously opened fey crossing and deposited into the Feywild. You must find your own way back. You draw no more cards.

cards.name: Fiend
cards.description: A powerful fiend offers a deal (task in exchange for reward). Indifferent and keeps its bargains.

faces.text: A powerful fiend (chosen by the GM) appears and offers you a deal — a task in exchange for a reward. The fiend is indifferent to you and honors its bargains, though it interprets them literally.

cards.name: Flames
cards.description: A powerful devil becomes your permanent enemy, seeking your ruin and death.

faces.text: A powerful devil becomes your enemy. The devil seeks your ruin and plagues your life, savoring your suffering before attempting to slay you. Its identity is known only to the GM until it chooses to reveal itself. This enmity lasts until either you or the devil dies.

cards.name: Fool
cards.description: Lose 1,000 XP, discard this card, and draw two more (counts as one declared draw).

faces.text: You lose 1,000 XP, discard this card, and draw two more cards beyond your declared draws. If the loss exceeds the experience you have earned toward your current level, it costs you a level.

cards.name: Gem
cards.description: 25 pieces of jewelry (2,000 gp each) OR 50 gems (1,000 gp each) appear at your feet.

faces.text: Twenty-five pieces of jewelry worth 2,000 gp each, or fifty gems worth 1,000 gp each, appear at your feet. Choose one option.

cards.name: Giant
cards.description: You grow 2d10 inches; your HP maximum and current HP increase by 20.

faces.text: You grow 2d10 inches taller, and your hit point maximum and current hit points each increase by 20.

cards.name: Humanoid
cards.description: You may stop drawing regardless of the declared number.

faces.text: You can choose to stop drawing cards regardless of how many you originally declared. The remaining declared draws are forfeited.

cards.name: Jester
cards.description: Gain 1,000 XP, or draw two additional cards beyond your declared draws.

faces.text: You gain 1,000 XP — a full level's worth — or you can choose instead to draw two additional cards beyond your declared draws.

cards.name: Key
cards.description: An uncommon or rarer magic weapon appears in your hands, and you can wield it.

faces.text: An uncommon or rarer magic weapon suddenly appears in your hands. You gain whatever proficiency you need to wield it, if you lacked it.

cards.name: Knight
cards.description: A warrior of your own level and ancestry appears and serves you loyally until death.

faces.text: You gain the service of a warrior who appears in a space you choose within 30 feet. They are of your level and share your ancestry, and they serve you loyally until death.

cards.name: Lance
cards.description: Every one of your ability modifiers increases by 1, to a maximum of +7.

faces.text: Each of your ability modifiers increases by 1, to a maximum of +7. The boost is permanent.

cards.name: Mage
cards.description: Your Intelligence modifier increases by 1, to a maximum of +7.

faces.text: Your Intelligence modifier increases by 1, to a maximum of +7. The boost is permanent.

cards.name: Map
cards.description: Within 1 year, mentally name an object or person to learn its location, distance, and condition.

faces.text: At any time within the next year, you can mentally name a specific object or person you have seen and instantly learn its current location, distance from you, and general condition. The card's magic is expended after one use.

cards.name: Maze
cards.description: You become Fatigued, and Drained 1 or 2 besides.

faces.text: Roll 1d3. You become Fatigued; on a 2 or 3 you are also Drained 1 or Drained 2 respectively. The conditions are removed by the usual means.

cards.name: Mine
cards.description: 2d6 gems (5,000 gp each) plus 1d10 ore chunks (2,500 gp each) appear.

faces.text: 2d6 gems worth 5,000 gp each and 1d10 chunks of precious ore worth 2,500 gp each appear at your feet.

cards.name: Monstrosity
cards.description: A Large or larger creature appears, hostile, and attacks the whole party.

faces.text: A Large or larger creature appears in an unoccupied space within 60 feet of you, of a level chosen to threaten your whole party rather than you alone. It is hostile and attacks immediately.

cards.name: Moon
cards.description: Call on a divine miracle 1d3 times.

faces.text: You gain the ability to call on a divine miracle 1d3 times. The GM adjudicates the scope of each; the uses are tracked on your sheet.

cards.name: Ooze
cards.description: An ooze appears in your space and tries to engulf you (hostile).

faces.text: An ooze appears in your space and immediately attempts to engulf you: a gelatinous cube at first, and heavier things as you grow. It is hostile and will pursue you if you escape.

cards.name: Path
cards.description: Your walking speed increases by 10 feet.

faces.text: Your walking speed permanently increases by 10 feet.

cards.name: Pit
cards.description: You fall 3d6×10 feet, taking falling damage; you land prone.

faces.text: The ground beneath you opens into a chasm. You fall 3d6 × 10 feet, taking falling damage on landing, and end prone.

cards.name: Plant
cards.description: Cast Speak with Plants once per day without spending a spell slot.

faces.text: You can cast Speak with Plants once per day without expending a spell slot.

cards.name: Priest
cards.description: Your Wisdom modifier increases by 1, to a maximum of +7.

faces.text: Your Wisdom modifier increases by 1, to a maximum of +7. The boost is permanent.

cards.name: Prisoner
cards.description: Magical force chains restrain you; you cannot cast spells; you draw no more cards.

faces.text: Chains of magical force wrap around you, restraining you. You cannot cast spells while restrained by these chains, and you draw no more cards. The chains persist until dispelled or removed by powerful magic.

cards.name: Puzzle
cards.description: Your Intelligence modifier drops by 1d4+1; draw one additional card.

faces.text: Your Intelligence score decreases by 1d4+1 (minimum 1). You must also draw one additional card beyond your declared draws.

cards.name: Ring
cards.description: An uncommon or rarer magic ring appears on your finger and is invested automatically.

faces.text: An uncommon or rarer magic ring appears on your finger. It is invested to you automatically, if you have an investiture available.

cards.name: Rogue
cards.description: A non-player character you know becomes your enemy; only a wish-tier miracle ends it.

faces.text: A non-player character of the GM's choice becomes hostile toward you. The identity of your new enemy is not known until they or someone else reveals it. Nothing short of a wish-tier divine miracle can end their hostility.

cards.name: Ruin
cards.description: All non-magical wealth you own is lost; property and ownership documentation disappear.

faces.text: All forms of non-magical wealth you carry or own vanish. Portable property is reduced to dust; documents that establish your ownership also disappear, along with the deeds and titles.

cards.name: Sage
cards.description: Within 1 year, ask one question in meditation and receive a truthful answer with attendant wisdom.

faces.text: At any time within the next year, you can meditate for one hour and ask a single question. You receive a truthful answer and gain any additional wisdom the answer entails. The card's magic is expended after one use.

cards.name: Shield
cards.description: An uncommon or rarer suit of magic armor appears on your body.

faces.text: An uncommon or rarer suit of magic armor appears on your body. If you lack the proficiency to wear it, you gain a +2 item bonus to AC from it regardless while it remains.

cards.name: Ship
cards.description: Become Trained in three skills of the GM's choice, or advance one step if already Trained.

faces.text: You become Trained in three skills chosen by the GM, or advance one proficiency step in them if you are already Trained.

cards.name: Skull
cards.description: An avatar of death at your own level attacks you; any it kills cannot be raised.

faces.text: You summon an avatar of death — a ghostly humanoid skeleton clad in a tattered black robe, of your own level. It appears in an unoccupied space of the GM's choice within 10 feet of you and attacks you, warning all others that you must win the battle alone. Creatures it slays cannot be restored to life by any means short of a wish.

cards.name: Staff
cards.description: An uncommon or rarer magic staff, wand, or rod appears in your hands.

faces.text: An uncommon or rarer magical implement — a staff, wand, or rod, at the GM's choice — appears in your hands.

cards.name: Stairway
cards.description: An uncommon or rarer wondrous item appears in your hands.

faces.text: An uncommon or rarer wondrous item appears in your hands.

cards.name: Star
cards.description: Increase one ability modifier of your choice by 1, to a maximum of +7.

faces.text: Increase one ability modifier of your choice by 1, to a maximum of +7. You choose which ability when the card is applied.

cards.name: Statue
cards.description: You are petrified — removable only by remove petrification or a wish-tier ritual.

faces.text: You are turned to stone (Petrified condition). You remain petrified until freed by Greater Restoration, Wish, or comparable magic.

cards.name: Sun
cards.description: Gain 2,000 XP (two levels); a random uncommon+ wondrous item appears.

faces.text: You gain 2,000 XP, and a random wondrous item of uncommon rarity or greater appears in your possession.

cards.name: Talons
cards.description: All your magic items disintegrate; artifacts vanish but survive.

faces.text: Every magic item you wear or carry disintegrates. Artifacts in your possession are not destroyed but vanish to another location.

cards.name: Tavern
cards.description: Your Charisma modifier increases by 1, to a maximum of +7.

faces.text: Your Charisma modifier increases by 1, to a maximum of +7. The boost is permanent.

cards.name: Temple
cards.description: A deity is bound to aid you once via divine intervention or Resurrection.

faces.text: A deity of the GM's choice is bound to aid you once, either through divine intervention or by a Resurrection spell cast on your behalf. The debt is honored once and then expended.

cards.name: Throne
cards.description: Advance in Diplomacy, and gain the deed to a monster-held keep.

faces.text: You advance one proficiency step in Diplomacy, to Expert at the least. You also become the rightful owner of a small keep in a distant land — though it is currently held by monsters you must clear out before you can claim it.

cards.name: Tomb
cards.description: Within a year, cast Resurrect once without spending a spell slot or components.

faces.text: At any time within the next year you can cast Resurrect, heightened as far as your level allows, once without expending a spell slot or material components. After that use the card's magic is spent.

cards.name: Tower
cards.description: Draw 2 additional cards; keep one and return the other to the deck.

faces.text: You immediately draw two additional cards. Choose one of the two to keep as if you had drawn it normally, and return the other to the deck.

cards.name: Tree
cards.description: While unarmoured you gain a +2 item bonus to AC, and weakness 5 to fire.

faces.text: Your skin toughens into bark. While you wear no armour you gain a +2 item bonus to AC, and you take weakness 5 to fire. PF2e has no way to set an unarmoured AC outright, so the bonus is the closest equivalent.

cards.name: Undead
cards.description: A revenant hunts you for a year, until your death, or until a miracle ends it.

faces.text: An undead revenant rises with the singular purpose of destroying you. It hunts you for one year or until you die. A wish-tier miracle ends the pursuit.

cards.name: Void
cards.description: Your soul is trapped in an object and your body left incapacitated; a wish-tier miracle reveals where. You draw no more cards.

faces.text: Your soul is drawn from your body and imprisoned in an object at a distant, secret location. Your body is left incapacitated. A wish-tier divine miracle can reveal where the object lies; recovering your soul still requires going to get it. You draw no more cards.

cards.name: Warrior
cards.description: Your Strength modifier increases by 1, to a maximum of +7.

faces.text: Your Strength modifier increases by 1, to a maximum of +7. The boost is permanent.

cards.name: Well
cards.description: Learn three cantrips of your choice from any tradition.

faces.text: You learn three cantrips of your choice from any magical tradition. The GM adjudicates your casting statistics for them.
